title: [BUG] "MCP Tools Not Available in Conversation Interface Despite Successful Connection"
author: didierphmartin

top_comments.author: Mahloc
top_comments.body:
Version 0.12.28 is also affected
Windows 11 with Python MCP servers
Same symptoms: server runs, shows as "running", but tools don't appear

top_comments.author: fitd-tech
top_comments.body:
I'm experiencing this as well. A test MCP server I made fails to register tools with both Claude Clode and Claude Desktop, but the Anthropic example [Fetch MCP server](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/tree/main/src/fetch) connects and exposes tools fine. This tells me that it's possible to expose the tools, but I cannot find any fundamental difference in the implementation.
